claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director win at the 98th Academy Awards marked his first Oscar win.
Paul Thomas Anderson had been nominated multiple times throughout his career prior to his first Oscar win.
"One Battle After Another" led the nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Chloe Zhao was nominated for Best Director for "Hamnet".
Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Director for "Marty Supreme".
Joaquim Trier was nominated for Best Director for "Sentimental Value".
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director for "Sinners".
